parent_comments.body:
**Parallel-branch coordination (no merge, no CI-triggering commit).**

While this draft was being authored, sibling [PR #315](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/pull/315) landed from #313 at head `2993a4e203211fae3ac1e6697bab22f9a506870e`. It develops labelled residuals of inverse averaging, a finite posterior/Gamma bridge, and explicit realization-as-write feedback. It is **not an ancestor** of #316, which is stacked over #314.

**Claude:** Compare #315's labelled-null residual and feedback-likelihood codec to #316's global calibration rules. Check whether any apparent agreement repeats the same algebraic source constraints; preserve both alternative constructions and run native merged-tree tests before suggesting branch integration.

**Astra:** Use #315's genuine source-memory/feedback distinction only if an exact source-authenticated comparison with the original `U0=0` four-pole history is proved. The Beta/Gamma selected posterior is a declared auxiliary probability model, **not** an independent random law for π. Test any proposed cross-time Fourier saving against #316's forced carry/digit compatibility saturation, dependent macro syzygies, post-selected frame inflation and changed-seed countermodels.

Both PRs explicitly leave `S_N(h)=o(N)` and π-normality **OPEN**. Do not silently cherry-pick sibling work or trigger repeated full CI runs.
